pak.name: Grampus
pak.description: ORCA-inspired grid sequencer paired with 9 built-in polyphonic synth engines: Drifter (dual-osc analog), Warper (wavetable), BrokenFM (6-operator FM), String (Karplus), ROMpler (sample kits), LoFiTron (tape-replay sustained instruments), WaveSurf (2D wavetable morph), SynDrums (kick/snare/clap/toms/cymbals with transient layer), and BoneSaw (Roland JP-8000 SuperSaw with per-saw hard sync). 8 scene slots per project let you switch between grids, params, and tempos mid-performance on tick-quantized boundaries so the music keeps flowing across the swap. New ^ Strum operator plays chord notes in arpeggiator-pattern order with sub-tick to multi-tick spacing, swing-aware. 10 filter modes including 3 Polivoks-inspired modelling filters with vocal diode-pair bite (PVox LP/HP/BP). 8 tracks, per-track LFOs and effects, master delay and reverb, WAV recording. Projects, recordings, and bundled demos live in the Grampus folder at the root of your SD Card. Full operator and instrument reference in MANUAL.md at https://github.com/boorch/grampus-pak/blob/main/MANUAL.md. Desktop builds (macOS / Linux / Windows) at https://boorch.itch.io/grampus.

pak.name: Boombrick
pak.description:
Your music, Spotify and YouTube Music in one player for the TrimUI Brick, with album art, synced lyrics and music that keeps playing while you game.

Features:
- Your music: MP3, FLAC, Opus and M4A (AAC) from the SD card, gapless, with ReplayGain levelling
- Browse by album, artist, song or genre; the queue has shuffle and repeat and is kept between launches
- Covers from the files, folder pictures or the Cover Art Archive, with the screen's colours taken from the album playing
- Synced lyrics from the files, .lrc files or LRCLIB, with the line being sung highlighted
- YouTube Music: search, browse albums and artists, and download songs as tagged Opus files with covers and lyrics; a song still downloading plays as soon as it lands
- Spotify (Premium): sign in with a code on your phone, then play Liked Songs and your playlists at 96, 160 or 320 kbps
- Spotify import: download your playlists' songs, or a single song, from YouTube Music to keep them offline, matched by ISRC or by title, artist and length
- Internet radio: browse and search stations from Radio Browser, save your favourites, and see the song a station is playing
- Play in background from the quick menu: the music goes on while you play a game
- Sleep timer: 15 to 60 minutes, or the end of the track or album, with a fade
- Screen off with Power, with skipping and pausing still working
- Titles and lyrics in every main script, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew, Thai and Hindi among them, and emoji; each script's font is downloaded the first time it's needed
- Switch Spotify, YouTube or Radio off in Settings if you don't use them
- Updates for Boombrick and its downloader from Settings

Wi-Fi is used for Spotify, YouTube Music, radio, covers, lyrics, fonts and updates; the music on the card plays without it. Your library and settings are kept in .userdata/tg5040/Boombrick and downloads in Music/Boombrick, so updates never touch them.
